column2: [intro]
I was sad and lost in my life,
A broken heart, alone in boredom.
But I decided to smile, to have fun,
Why mope, better to laugh about it!
If you own it, it's no longer bad taste,
Let's forget the sorrows, come on, let's be crazy!
Let's dance and sing, let's party endlessly,
Because it's in laughing that we find happiness, finally!
People look at me strangely,
But I don't care, I'm different.
I dare to be myself, with all my madness,
Life is too short, might as well enjoy it!
If you own it, it's no longer bad taste,
Let's forget the sorrows, come on, let's be crazy!
Let's dance and sing, let's party endlessly,
Because it's in laughing that we find happiness, finally!
